drivingQuestion: Does the halakha follow Rabbi Eliezer or Rabban Gamliel on festivals that cancel mourning?

segments.he: רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹמֵר: מִשֶּׁחָרַב בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ עֲצֶרֶת כַּשַּׁבָּת וְכוּ׳. אָמַר רַב גִּידֵּל בַּר מְנַשְּׁיָא אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל: הֲלָכָה כְּרַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל.
segments.en: § The mishna taught: «Rabbi Eliezer says: Since the Temple was destroyed, Shavuot is like Shabbat» with regard to mourning. Rabban Gamliel says: Even Rosh HaShana and Yom Kippur are considered like Festivals. The Gemara comments that «Rav Giddel bar Menashya said» that «Shmuel said: The halakha is in accordance with» the opinion of «Rabban Gamliel.»
